features.title: Plain HTML Sentence Rendering; As a Consumer of HTML output, I want the HTML sentence to appear on one line so that the format matches the approved requirement; As a Business Analyst, I want to verify one-line HTML formatting so that requirement acceptance can be confirmed against FR-01 (+7 more)

openQuestions.text: Does “appear on one line” refer to:
both rendered output and source markup,
Are there any approved UI designs or requirement documents defining where this output is displayed?
Are there accessibility or readability expectations for long single-line output?
